title: Analyze 21 corrections for agent improvement patterns
body: Corrections log has 21 entries.\nRecent: ## 2026-03-20: Proposals must be live, not cron-only Proposals should come from every agent touchpoint — not just periodic cron scans. Sources: Right Hand during conversations, dispatch completions, self-improvement hook failures, feed errors, heartbeat issues, vault writes, and the UI itself. Use\nAnalyze and propose SOUL.md improvements.

tasks.description: Analyze corrections.md and feedback.md for recurring patterns. Group by category (scope, quality, accuracy).
Based on pattern analysis, propose 1-3 specific changes to SOUL.md or agent prompts. Write changes as a patch to vault/Research/agent-improvements-2026-03-20.md
